video.title: This Is What One Phone Check Does to Your Focus

elements.content: Watch what one phone check does to this timer.
Text, homework, email, text again. Every switch slows you down.
Rubinstein et al., 2001 · J Exp Psych
In one 2001 lab study, switching tasks made people slower.
Just a quick peek? The timer starts over.
One: one task, and a twenty-minute timer you can see.
Two: phone face down, in another room.
Three: a stray thought? Write it on a later list.
Try it today, and watch the ice melt.
